thread:
noah.k: Quick sync: ops wants a minimal runtime flow to pick fp8/int8/4bit per request. We need a hot cheap probe + occasional stronger checks. thoughts?
maria.chen: Keep hot probe O(1) and derived from the low-bit logits if possible. e.g., top1-logit margin or single-token logp.
anya.v: Margin z-score normalized by EMA per-endpoint sounds good. thresholding on z is simple and fast.
noah.k: Where to keep EMA? local per-instance for scale, central redis for dedicated customers. document both.
maria.chen: Golden checks: sample small fraction (0.1%) and run full-precision async. if golden failure rate > threshold -> auto-rollback.
anya.v: Telemetry minimal fields: precision, probe_z, gate_action, sample_id. keeps storage light.
noah.k: Decision API idea: decide_precision(meta, logits, ema) -> {precision, reason}. deterministic so rollbacks are easy.
maria.chen: Add header opt-out x-precision-pin. ops UI can expose sliders mapping to margin_z and sample_rate.
runtime-bot: Canary deploy: light-probe-v1 -> staging 2024-12-01T02:00Z.
noah.k: I'll prototype the margin z implementation and post perf numbers.
summary: Short thread on hot probe (margin z), EMA modes, golden checks, telemetry, and rollout
